create_pipeline_audio_to_embedding: create an audio-to-embedding pipeline using HFAudioToEmbeddingPipeline with a specified encoder model and device
build_audio_dataset_config: build an AudioDatasetConfig for loading and processing audio datasets with a target sampling rate and audio column
process_audio_column_dataset: process the audio column of a dataset by casting it to the target sampling rate for downstream embedding generation
collect_valid_audio_inputs: collect and validate audio inputs from a list of dictionaries, converting them to normalized PyTorch tensors
run_batch_embedding_generation: run batch processing on audio data to generate embeddings using the configured encoder model and parallel workers
